paper_title: Can Language Models Follow Multiple Turns of Entangled Instructions

model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of 1,100 samples across nine capabilities within a study examining language models' ability to follow complex instructions. The chart contains nine slices, presented in a clockwise circular arrangement. These slices represent "Privacy Protection" (in pink), "Multitasking" (in green), "Context Retrieving" (in gray), "Context Tracking" (in white), "Contradiction Resolution" (in yellow), "Dynamic Environment" (in blue), "Memorization" (in dark blue), "Dynamic Instruction" (in light blue), and “Recursive Reasoning” (in red). Each slice is labelled with a corresponding capability name and a numerical value, ranging from 100 to 160. A legend is absent, and no percentage labels are displayed within the slices themselves. The segments appear ordered visually by decreasing sample values, with "Multitasking" having the highest numerical value and “Recursive Reasoning” the lowest.
